title: Circular Thigh Rubbing
summary: Controlled circular movements over the large thigh muscles.
goal: Gradually warm soft tissue before kneading.
startingPosition: The leg rests stably and relaxed.
instructions: Place the palm on the muscular thigh.
Make small circles that move with tissue.
direction: Small circles over the thigh muscles.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
